key_insight: HemOncAgent is an AI tool that routes oncology questions to the best source—structured knowledge graph or narrative guideline text—to improve retrieval across drug and regimen questions.
clinical_relevance: It may help clinicians and researchers find more reliable oncology treatment information by combining facts from databases with context from care-pathway narratives.
method: Selects between HemOncKB for structured pharmacologic relationships
Uses HemOnc.org for clinician-authored narrative treatment pathways
Benchmarked across structured and narrative question types
evidence_signal: The abstract reports high-fidelity retrieval across multiple benchmark question types, including cases where single-source systems had domain-specific limitations.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality, coverage, and maintenance of the underlying knowledge sources and on correct tool selection for each question.
paper_title: HemOncAgent: an artificial intelligence system for retrieving structured and narrative oncology knowledge
